note: the figure methods on seeds 0-19 (0-2: the dense runs, on the final or maze retime clock; 3-19: the same recipes, each run alone on its GPU, checkpoints scored afterwards with the same probe). Rows are [fit_s, probe solved %, update]; fit_s is the run's fit clock after that update. Sudoku bptt and maze pl are the long runs of runs/ALT/long/ on seeds 0-19 (updates in "long").
ready_note: ready_s: seconds to fit the stopping threshold, focus statistic and search unit from the training solutions (Sudoku; 0 on the maze), measured on the final runs of seeds 0-2. Training time to an inference-ready model = fit_s - start-up + ready_s.
